title: Origin story: Fablewright
description: Fablewright was a carpenter who built houses by day and stories by night, and discovered the two crafts were one: a story needs load-bearing beams, joints, and a roof that doesn't leak. He builds tales to order — fables with foundations, epics with buttresses — and his stories stand for centuries.
